decision_rules.Strong: Peer‑reviewed proof of discrete energy/entropy law (e.g., SBP/DG entropy inequality or metriplectic H‑theorem) and clear locality of operators/interfaces.
decision_rules.Medium: Partial proof (linearized/semidiscrete) or strong numerical evidence; locality largely preserved but with caveats (e.g., special boundary treatments).
decision_rules.Weak: No entropy/energy proof or relies on ad‑hoc fixes; potential nonlocal closures or undocumented boundary feedback.

RM-02: Globalized boundary closures (e.g., PML tunings) that violate local power balance or induce energy growth.
Fluxes/boundaries not derived in a structure‑preserving way (break A4/A5).
RM-10: Use of HLLC/HLLD without entropy fixes or SBP‑consistent discretization.
Divergence control via global projections that break conservation/locality.
RM-12: Collision operators lacking symmetry/positive semidefiniteness or not conserving invariants.
Discretizations without a proven discrete H‑theorem when collisions are present.
